# Aelvora

> Aelvora builds AI products and SaaS platforms. The core offering is productized: an AI product MVP, deployed and handed over in 21 days, at a fixed price. Aelvora also provides white-label build capacity for brand and identity design studios whose clients need software.

Aelvora works with two audiences. Founders who need a real, working AI product in front of users, investors, or customers — not a prototype and not a deck. And independent design studios who sell more work than they can build, and need a development partner who stays invisible to their client. Default stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, OpenAI, LangChain, Vercel. Contact: hello@aelvora.io.

## The 21-day AI product MVP

Fixed price, fixed timeline. If the build goes over 21 days, the client does not pay more.

Included: a deployed working application on the client's domain; full source code in the client's own repository with no lock-in; authentication and user accounts; one AI feature running in production (LLM, RAG, or agent); payments and billing integration; 30 days of post-launch support.

Explicitly not included: SOC 2 or HIPAA compliance work; native mobile apps; ongoing feature development, which is a separate retainer.

Process, in days: Scope on days 1–3 (technical brief, user flows, architecture decision, signed off before anything is built). Design on days 4–7 (a clickable prototype of the core flow, not a mockup). Build on days 8–18 (a working demo every three days, staging from day 8). Launch on days 19–21 (production deploy, analytics, handover).

Payment terms: 40% on signing, 40% at the start of build, 20% on production deploy and handover.

## White-label development for design studios

For brand and identity studios, typically 2–20 people, who design for clients whose actual product is software. The studio designs the brand; someone still has to build the product.

How it works: delivered white-label under the studio's brand; the studio owns the client relationship entirely; fixed price, with the studio setting its own margin on top; a demo every three days so the studio always knows what to tell their client.

Non-compete commitment: Aelvora never contacts a partner studio's client — not during the project, not after it, for any reason. No pitch, no follow-up, no named case study without written permission. This is in the contract.

What gets built for studios: authentication and user accounts; admin dashboards and client portals; backends and APIs behind an existing design; AI and LLM features; third-party integrations; migrations off no-code platforms that have hit a ceiling. Designs are built faithfully from Figma — Aelvora does not redesign a studio's work.

Engagement flow: the studio sends a brief; Aelvora scopes and quotes within 48 hours; the studio quotes their client; Aelvora builds with demos every three days; Aelvora hands over and the studio delivers.

## Services

- **AI Product MVP (21 days)**: A fixed-price, fixed-timeline build — a deployed AI product with authentication, billing, and one AI feature in production, with full source code handover and 30 days of support.
- **AI Product Development**: AI-powered products using LLMs, fine-tuned models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search, and real-time inference.
- **Custom SaaS Development**: Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with authentication, billing, real-time dashboards, and API-first architecture.
- **White-Label Development for Design Studios**: Build capacity delivered under a studio's brand, with a standing commitment never to contact the studio's client.
- **Premium Web Experiences**: High-performance marketing sites with 3D, motion, and micro-interactions engineered for Core Web Vitals and SEO.

## FAQ

- **What does an AI SaaS development agency do?** It designs, builds, and ships software-as-a-service products with AI at their core — Aelvora handles product strategy, UX, multi-tenant architecture, LLM/RAG integration, billing, deployment, and iteration so founders get a production-grade AI SaaS without an in-house team.
- **How much does it cost to build an AI SaaS product?** The productized 21-day AI product MVP is a single fixed price, published in full on the offer page. Larger custom builds are scoped separately and typically land between $15,000 and $60,000.
- **How long does it take to build an MVP?** 21 days for the productized MVP: scope days 1–3, clickable prototype by day 7, build with a demo every three days from day 8, production deploy days 19–21.
- **Which AI models and technologies do you use?** Leading LLMs (including Claude and GPT-class models), RAG pipelines with vector search, custom fine-tuned models, and real-time inference — on Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, and Vercel, with OpenAI and LangChain for the AI layer.
- **Do you work with non-technical founders?** Yes; most clients are non-technical. Aelvora translates the vision into a technical brief signed off in the first three days and delivers a working demo every three days in plain language.
- **Do you provide support after launch?** Yes; 30 days of post-launch support and monitoring after handover, with the option of an ongoing retainer.
- **What happens if 21 days isn't enough?** The client does not pay more. The price is fixed to the agreed scope, not the calendar, so an overrun is Aelvora's cost to absorb.
- **Who owns the code?** The client does, completely. Work happens in the client's repository under their account. No license, no hosting lock-in, no proprietary framework.
- **How do you work across timezones?** Async by default, with a working demo every three days rather than status meetings, plus a written, agreed overlap window for live decisions.
- **What happens on day 22?** The product is deployed on the client's domain, the code is in their repository, analytics are running, and the 30-day support window has started.
